g.title: ER
g.text: WhatsApp Messaging Database: ER Diagram (schema whatsapp)

g.title: legend
g.text: PK = primary key (yellow rows) FK = foreign key UQ = unique
Bar at the parent end = one; crow's foot at the child end = many
Circle at the parent end = optional (NULL allowed)
chat_members = users M:N chats; message_receipts = users M:N messages
blocked_users = users M:N users (blocker, blocked); messages.reply_to_message_id = self-reference
